blocks.head: alt Either user invites the other user
alt Any existing UserX and Device
alt UserX has key and the device exists
alt Any existing UserX and Device
alt UserY is a member of UserX in the cloud

state_rules.rule:
eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : UserDevice , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : UserDevice , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ....) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > < DeviceX | ('key' : Key , ....) > $ UserX 'requestKey' cloudA | (DeviceX) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > < DeviceX | ('key' : Key , ....) > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (DeviceX ; Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (DeviceX ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : OldKey , ..) > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (DeviceX ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : OldKey , ..) > .

eq < deviceA | ('key' : Key , 'on' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceA | (Key) 
= < deviceA | ('key' : Key , 'on' : true , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ..) , ...) > < deviceA | ('on' : false , ....) > $ UserX 'cloudTurnOn' cloudA | (deviceA) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ..) , ...) > < deviceA | ('on' : true , ....) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ..) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceValue , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, UserY) @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceValue , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > < DeviceX | (....) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, DeviceX) @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > < DeviceX | (....) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > < UserX | (....) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, DeviceX) @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > < UserX | (....) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('key' : DeviceKey , 'on' : On , ...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('key' : DeviceKey , 'on' : On , ...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > < DeviceX | (....) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX) @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > < DeviceX | (....) > .

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Rest) , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX, UserY) @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Rest) , 'device' : DeviceX , ..) , ...) > .
